data.narrative:
Nu Quantum is a Series A quantum computing company that has raised $60M to date. The broader quantum computing sector comprises 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

The valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, as peer-median comparison is not applicable. The quantum computing private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—of 8 total sector peers identified, none meet the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints within narrow valuation tiers. Applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression to the $60M raised proxy yields $120M implied value.

The triangulated valuation range is $102M to $138M, with a median of $120M. This single-method estimate carries material execution risk. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to the named peer set, pathway to commercialization timelines, and capital efficiency relative to comparable companies in the quantum stack. Refinement would benefit from access to follow-on funding patterns and revenue/customer metrics among peer companies, which remain unavailable in the current dataset.
